subject: Issues with DT and Buttons plugin when using container option

messages.author: c1629c4c1cffcc0e
messages.subject: Issues with DT and Buttons plugin when using container option
parts:
Hello there,

We are having a very interesting problem when using DT and Buttons along with the container option.  All versions are the latest stable release.

Our intended functionality is to create a 1- or 2-row header container based off of the column names, while also allowing the user to use the HTML5 “Copy” function from the Buttons plugin.

When we do add the container option, only 1 column of data is copied.  When we remove the container option, all data is copied as expected.

Has anyone experienced any issues like this?  Any suggestion on how we can regain the working copy functionality from Buttons?

~ Laz Peterson
